title: Cow wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='33' ry='24' fill='#f5f0e6'/>

  <rect x='26' y='78' width='9' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <rect x='40' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <rect x='60' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <rect x='72' y='78' width='9' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='26' y='90' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='40' y='90' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='90' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='72' y='90' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>

  <ellipse cx='22' cy='26' rx='4.5' ry='2.5' fill='#e8a0b0' transform='rotate(-20 22 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='26' rx='4.5' ry='2.5' fill='#e8a0b0' transform='rotate(20 78 26)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='15' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#e8d9a0' transform='rotate(-25 36 15)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='15' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#e8d9a0' transform='rotate(25 64 15)'/>

  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3d3a5c'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='28' y='28' width='19' height='12' rx='4' fill='#2b2b6b'/>

  <rect x='46' y='31' width='8' height='3.5' fill='#2b2b6b'/>
  <rect x='30' y='30' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd8ff'/>
  <rect x='55' y='30' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd8ff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#f7c9d4'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='45' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#c98a9a'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='45' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#c98a9a'/>

  <path d='M45 50 Q50 54 55 50' stroke='#c98a9a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
